findings.title: Information Disclosure via UserInfo Logging in IndieAuth Provider
findings.impact: Personally identifiable information (PII) from OAuth userinfo responses is logged at INFO level, making it visible in production log aggregation systems and monitoring dashboards. This exposes authenticated user details including email, name, and other profile information.
findings.evidence: Line 95: log.Infof("indieauth userinfo body: %s", string(data)) - The entire userinfo response body is logged, which contains decoded user information from the IndieAuth provider. The INFO level ensures this logging occurs in production environments.
findings.recommendation: 1. Change logging level from INFO to DEBUG, OR 2. Mask sensitive fields before logging (redact email, name, etc.), OR 3. Only log specific non-sensitive fields needed for debugging. If changing to DEBUG level, ensure debug logging is disabled in production deployments.
